description:
W.F.O. 9
Wide, Full Open. That’s what the name means. Let ‘er go, full throttle, don’t slow down for anything, that’s what the name implies. With 5.5” of plush CVA™ suspension technology underfoot, there’s nothing stopping your 29” wheels except the human instinct to live another day.
LONG TRAVEL 29
We thought about all of the ways people might take advantage of having 5.5” of travel coupled with a 29” wheel and we designed the W.F.O. 9 to handle them all. The W.F.O. 9 went through exhaustive testing and refining, including a first for a 29er frame - a tapered headtube for increased front end stiffness and strength. A custom S-bend hydroformed downtube allows the use of both coil and piggyback shocks. The offset bottom linkage makes room for an ISCG03 mount and chain guide. Whatever your want from your trail bike, the W.F.O. 9 will keep you pinned all the way through any terrain you throw at it.
CVA SUSPENSION
The W.F.O. 9 features Niner’s patented CVA suspension (U.S. Patent No. 7,934,739) and delivers 140mm of fully active travel with superb compliance and damping via a custom-tuned RockShox Monarch Plus shock. For those seeking the advantages of 29” wheels combined with pedaling efficiency across all 3-chainrings, CVA is an obvious front-runner and results in a faster and smoother ride.
PROGRESSIVE GEOMETRY
"Confidence Inspiring" was our mantra when designing the W.F.O. 9. A head angle slack enough to feel unstoppable in steep and rocky terrain but not so slack as to pigeonhole the bike and sacrifice tight corner performance or low speed technical ability. In a long-travel 29 category that is growing rapidly, the W.F.O. 9 still leads the pack with its refined trail manners. The W.F.O. 9 is intended for 140 to 160mm forks, allowing riders to further fine tune the ride.
HYDROFORMED TUBING
The W.F.O. 9 shares the use of hydroformed tubing with the R.I.P. 9 and Jet 9 frames. Hydroforming allows us to carefully shape tubing and control wall thickness, optimizing strength and stiffness in key areas. This customization creates perfectly tuned frames with the exact ride characteristics we seek for every application.
TAPERED HEADTUBE
The W.F.O. 9 was our first model to incorporate a tapered headtube. The increased surface area of a tapered headtube allows for a larger downtube, increasing strength and rigidity at this critical intersection. Tapered fork steerer tubes measurably reduce fork deflection, which means your Niner tracks straight and true. The full spectrum of riders from XC racers to All Mountain shredders benefit from these features which is why we incorporate the technology in all our new frames. The W.F.O. 9 lets you take full advantage of increased steering precision as you attempt to crush all obstacles in your path.
ATTENTION TO DETAIL
Forged components for the chainstay and seatstay yokes provide increased stiffness and strength. Forged linkage parts increase strength and stiffness without any weight penalty. All linkage pivots are outfitted with Enduro Max full complement sealed cartridge bearings for smooth, friction-free suspension.
Serious, pedalable, all-mountain machine
Hydroformed tube construction
Enduro Max full complement sealed cartridge bearings in all linkage pivots
